newsitem.title: USA: SPS Transaction consumer accounts decline.
newsitem.headline: SPS Transaction consumer accounts decline.

text.p: SPS Transaction Services Inc said Wednesday its active consumer private label accounts fell 11 percent to 3.2 million in the first quarter compared with a year ago.
Total loans outstanding were $2.1 billion, down from $2.2 billion a year ago.
SPS provides services such as processing of credit card transactions, private label credit card programs and commercial accounts receivable processing.

"Our strategy over the past year has been highly focused," Robert Wieseneck, SPS president, said in a statement. "We continue to emphasize revenue growth in our fee-based businesses, while implementing measures to improve the profitability of our asset-based consumer credit card business, some of which have had the effect of inhibiting account growth."
Earlier, SPS reported first quarter earnings of $0.27 a share, down from $0.41 a year ago.
